components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Restrained white navigation with a fine active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #fff; padding: 0 0 5px; font: 500 12px/1.2 'Work Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: .3em; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Editorial Link
components.description: Text-led action with a fine underline and enlarged hit area.
components.css: .ds-editorial-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: #0a0a0a; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; font: 500 11px/1.3 'Work Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-editorial-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0a0a0a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Media Frame
components.description: Square-corner image frame whose crop follows the editorial composition.
components.css: .ds-media-frame { position: relative; width: 260px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; background: #eee; border-radius: 0; } .ds-media-placeholder { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: #f2f2ee; }

narrative.overview: A restrained bilingual editorial system where authentic fashion, showroom, and service imagery leads while the interface recedes.

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Color comes from content or a defined narrative surface, never generic decoration.

rules.name: The Role Rule
rules.body: Choose typography by content role rather than HTML heading level or available space.

dos: Test real Chinese and English copy at all three breakpoints.
Let authentic imagery carry the visual story.
donts: Do not shrink key text below the documented floor.
Do not repeat a brand name over an image that already contains its logo.
Do not replace hierarchy with decorative cards or shadows.
